scope: Local trusted-command controls only; no QQ execution, account state or production access.

documented_kernel_constraint.condition: CLONE_NEWUSER can return EPERM when the process root does not match its mount namespace root, including a chroot environment.

interpretation: This WSL environment does permit the tested unprivileged user namespace outside the chroot; global user-namespace unavailability is not established.
The existing filesystem boundary prevents the tested user namespace. The observed contrast is consistent with the documented chroot constraint.
These are related but not otherwise perfectly matched experimental arms: no claim is made that all other process details were identical.
The original QQ failure is not proof that independent QQ operation is impossible. The probe's filesystem boundary is a prerequisite to investigate.
Replacing the mount namespace root with a carefully reviewed pivot_root-style boundary is a future experiment, not a proven fix or an authorization to remove isolation.
